lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance, circular pixel clusters is visible on the lateral flank. The clusters are arranged in multiple horizontal rows, with the highest concentration and most distinct separation observed in the mid-flank region posterior to the branchial slits.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity are clearly visible, intersecting the horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a rectilinear grid of anchor nodes across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Multiple parallel linear features run horizontally across the upper third of the flank. These are defined by a distinct luminance gradient consisting of a high-intensity highlight on the superior edge and a low-intensity shadow on the inferior edge.
